findings.title: Lithuanian account message was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian `totpStep1` translation is now Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:"). Lithuanian account-console users will see an unrelated-language instruction during OTP setup; replace it with a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Lithuanian login message was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian `loginTotpStep1` value is Italian rather than Lithuanian. This is displayed in the login OTP enrollment flow, so Lithuanian users receive an incorrect-language instruction. Restore a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese resource now contains a Traditional Chinese translation
findings.body: `messages_zh_CN.properties` is the Simplified Chinese locale, but the new `totpStep1` value uses Traditional Chinese characters and wording (for example, "手機", "應用程式"). This produces inconsistent localization for `zh_CN` users; use a Simplified Chinese translation or place this text in the appropriate Traditional Chinese resource.
